min_standing_note.notes: Residence halls exclude students >=24 years old; College of Law exchange requires a completed bachelor's degree (p.2).

value: Practicums, seminars, and independent study (case-by-case only)
excluded_majors.notes: Medicine, Nursing, Law, and Dentistry require >=6 months advance application; Law requires completed Bachelor's; Graduate courses need departmental permission.

min_gpa_host.notes: Fact sheet p.2 states: 'MINIMUM GPA: 2.5/4.0. Students with a GPA of 2.0-2.49 may be considered on an individual basis. Course request list required for review.'

english_proficiency_and_rhet1020.value: Required for non-native English speakers: TOEFL iBT 79 / PBT 550, IELTS 6.5, or Duolingo English Test 105 (Fact sheet p.2; RHET 1020 / English-medium waiver not mentioned).

host_language_requirement.value: English (TOEFL iBT 79 / PBT 550, IELTS 6.5, or Duolingo 105 for non-native speakers).

fall_term_dates.value: Fall 2026: Registration Aug 17; Classes begin Aug 18, 2026; Fall Break Oct 9-11; Final Exam Week Dec 7-11, 2026 (arrive ~1 week prior for mandatory New International Student Orientation; no late arrivals).
fall_term_dates.notes: Orientation arrival & no-late-arrival rule on data/raw/factsheets/West Virginia/2025-2026/WVU 202526 Fact sheet.pdf#page=1.

spring_term_dates.value: Spring 2027: Registration Jan 8; Classes begin Jan 11, 2027; Final Exam Week May 3-7, 2027 (arrive ~1 week prior for mandatory New International Student Orientation; no late arrivals).
spring_term_dates.notes: Orientation arrival rule on data/raw/factsheets/West Virginia/2025-2026/WVU 202526 Fact sheet.pdf#page=1.

tuition_model.notes: WVU 2025-26 Fact Sheet notes a $150 USD admin fee and 'WVU Exchange Housing Waiver, if included in institutional agreement', without publicly printing a standard incoming tuition-waiver statement on educationabroad.wvu.edu/incoming.

est_monthly_living_local.notes: Derived from WVU 2026-27 average on-campus Food & Housing COA ($15,028/year divided across 10 academic months / two 5-month semesters = $1,502.80/month). Excludes $150 admin fee and SHIP health insurance ($1,277 Fall / $1,980 Spring-Summer); note select agreements include WVU Exchange Housing Waiver (Stalnaker Hall).

living_cost_usd_est.notes: 1 USD = 1.0 USD on 2026-11-15 (native USD); 5-month semester equivalent of WVU 2026-27 average Food & Housing COA ($15,028/yr / 2 = $7,514.00/semester), excluding $150 admin fee and health insurance.

mandatory_host_fees_and_insurance.value: WVU 2026-27 Aetna Student Health Insurance Plan (SHIP) premiums: $1,277 Fall, $1,980 Spring/Summer ($3,257 annual). J-1 exchange visitors must meet 22 CFR 62.14 insurance minimums ($100k medical, $25k repatriation, $50k evacuation, <=$500 deductible). WVU also charges a $150 USD exchange administration fee.
mandatory_host_fees_and_insurance.notes: J-1 insurance criteria at https://isss.wvu.edu/students-services/health-insurance-in-the-u-s; $150 administration fee at data/raw/factsheets/West Virginia/2025-2026/WVU 202526 Fact sheet.pdf#page=1.

housing_availability.notes: Global Live-Learn Community at Stalnaker Hall (covered by WVU Exchange Housing Waiver if included in partner agreement); students >=24 are ineligible for residence halls (University Apartments recommended for >19). Note WVU housing/dining close during breaks (Thanksgiving/Winter/Spring) — Fact sheet p.1.

housing_notes.value: Morgantown residence hall rates per semester: Traditional towers double ~$3,682, single ~$4,628; Stalnaker/Summit double suite ~$4,038-$4,133, single ~$4,759-$4,863; Honors/Lincoln double ~$4,660-$4,729, single ~$4,863-$4,936; Seneca studios $5,718-$6,248; $225 deposit and required dining plan.
housing_notes.notes: WVU 2025-26 Fact Sheet (data/raw/factsheets/West Virginia/2025-2026/WVU 202526 Fact sheet.pdf#page=1, #page=2) also specifies Global LLC at Stalnaker Hall (housing waiver if included in agreement), >=24 residence hall age cap, and hall/dining closures during breaks.

citizenship_restrictions.notes: Age rule for housing: students 24 years old or older are not permitted in WVU residence halls (Fact sheet p.2).

visa_lead_time_and_financial_proof.value: J-1 Visa requires Form DS-2019 from WVU ISSS supported by Proof of Financial Support (liquid bank statements <=6 months old or sponsor/award letters covering COA; add $9,700 per J-2 dependent) and 22 CFR 62.14 compliant health insurance.
visa_lead_time_and_financial_proof.notes: Financial documentation rules ($9,700/dependent) at https://isss.wvu.edu/students-services/new-student-on-boarding; Fact Sheet (data/raw/factsheets/West Virginia/2025-2026/WVU 202526 Fact sheet.pdf#page=2) also lists .../students/j-1-students.

english_course_list_url.notes: All coursework on Morgantown Campus delivered in English.

credit_system_and_load.value: US semester credit-hour system: mandatory minimum 12 credit hours/semester UG (courses 100-499) and 9 credit hours/semester GR (courses 500+).

course_restrictions_note.value: Morgantown Campus courses only (WVUIT and Potomac State not open; no online courses). Forensics, Pharmacy, and MBA closed; Medicine/Nursing/Law/Dentistry require 6-month advance application (Law requires bachelor's degree); graduate courses need departmental permission; practicums/seminars/independent study generally closed.

value: Home institution nomination emailed to incomingexchange@mail.wvu.edu (name, email, field, level)
Official transcript showing >=2.5 GPA (2.0-2.49 needs course request list for individual review)
English proficiency scores (TOEFL 79 / IELTS 6.5 / DET 105 for non-native speakers)
Proof of financial support for DS-2019
required_application_docs.notes: Academic/GPA/English & DS-2019 requirements on data/raw/factsheets/West Virginia/2025-2026/WVU 202526 Fact sheet.pdf#page=2.

campus_type.notes: Morgantown Campus spans Downtown, Evansdale, and Sunnyside neighborhoods in Morgantown, WV (WVUIT and Potomac State campuses are closed to exchange students).

international_support_services.value: Education Abroad (incomingexchange@mail.wvu.edu), International Students & Scholars Services (ISSS, https://isss.wvu.edu/), mandatory New International Student Orientation, scheduled shuttle pickups from Pittsburgh International Airport, Stalnaker Hall Global LLC, and Accessibility Services.
international_support_services.notes: ISSS/Accessibility/Emergency contact on data/raw/factsheets/West Virginia/2025-2026/WVU 202526 Fact sheet.pdf#page=2.

nomination_deadlines.value: Fall (Aug-Dec): Nomination Mar 15, Application Apr 1. Spring (Jan-May): Nomination Sep 1, Application Sep 15 (late apps case-by-case; Medicine/Nursing/Law/Dentistry >=6 months advance).
nomination_deadlines.notes: 6-month advance rule for health/law programs on p.2.
